directive.thread_id: trillion-workshop lane draw-pages-in-a-layout, 2026-11-20: the judged-text drawing step of the carousel workflow
directive.quote: Build and land ONE new Workshop tool, tool:draw-pages-in-a-layout: it draws a carousel's pages as 1080x1350 JPEGs from the exact judged page text, in a layout given as DATA, so nothing can be drawn that was not judged.

job: draw a deck's pages as JPEGs from the judged page text in a layout
banned_substitutions: A NO_PRIOR_OWNER claim for a renderer that draws words the judged text does not hold.
A footer, brand line or handle drawn by the tool.

distinct_from.why: Runs and pools browser sessions for scripted page work; it opens pages and takes no judged words, lays out no pages and writes no JPEG.
Drives a headless browser over DevTools for page inspection; it reads and acts on live pages, it does not draw a fixed-size deck from text.
Walks an app through a browser as a user would; it screenshots an app's screens, not text laid out on pages of a deck.
Composes 1280x720 thumbnails from video frames with fixed templates and Pillow text; it draws no HTML, takes no line-form page text and has no overflow check.

phrasings: draw a deck's pages as JPEGs from the judged page text in a layout
pages as JPEG from the judged text
